name: Research / publication activity
product_relevance_reason: Publication activity bears on research momentum and emerging technical domains, as a proxy.
exact_world_state_unit: a publication registration event, such as a DOI registration

routes.basis: the registration agency records the event
routes.note: A DOI registration is an event Crossref performs and records. It is the authoritative publisher of it.
Its own help centre states it harvests rather than indexes directly. Harvesting Crossref is not a second measurement of a Crossref registration.
source_says: We don't index journals directly — we harvest Crossref and friends, so get in there first.

same_proposition_reason: §15 warns that index diversity is not measurement independence, and this is that case exactly, established on the aggregator's own words. PubMed indexes a different and overlapping corpus under its own criteria, which makes it a different population rather than a second witness.
